title: Ex-USPTO Examiner Alexander Harrison Joins Solve Intelligence
summary: Former USPTO Patent Examiner and patent attorney Alex Harrison joins Solve Intelligence with 14 years of experience from the USPTO and private practice.
body_markdown:
We’re delighted to welcome Alex Harrison to Solve Intelligence as our newest Legal and Product Engineer.


Alex is a registered U.S. patent attorney who began his career as a Patent Examiner at the United States Patent and Trademark Office.


Alex joins us from Morgan, Lewis & Bockius in Washington, D.C., and previously practiced at Kilpatrick Townsend & Stockton. His practice centered on patent prosecution, including building and managing global patent portfolios to help clients meet their business goals. Beyond prosecution, he has conducted freedom-to-operate and patentability analyses, supported IP due diligence for M&A transactions, and worked on patent litigation matters before the International Trade Commission and in federal district court.


Alex holds a B.S. in Civil Engineering from the University of Virginia and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center.


Having worked on both sides of patent examination, first as an examiner and then as a practitioner, Alex brings a uniquely well-rounded view of what makes a patent application and an office action response succeed. At Solve Intelligence, he’ll put that experience to work helping us continue to build the most capable AI tools for every stage of the patent process.


Please join us in welcoming Alex to the team!
